1.consolidated_definition: Yerba que alcanza diez metros de altura, con hojas de dos metros de largo y de cuatro a siete centímetros de ancho. (Gynerium sagittatum, Aubl., Beauw.). Otero, 20. “Pero, si no hay palmeras... se substituyen con hierba seca o con paja de caña, caña india, etc.” Meléndez Muñoz, , p. 23.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
A grass that reaches a height of ten meters, with leaves two meters long and four to seven centimeters wide. (Gynerium sagittatum, Aubl., Beauw.). Otero, 20. "However, if there are no palms... they are substituted with dry grass or with pith from cane, Indian cane, etc." Meléndez Muñoz, , p. 23.
